research_question: If we guarantee a board slot for oracle-acquired seeded cores, does acquisition become persistent 2+ core assembly?

policy_config.purpose: Phase 2G board-slot deployment stress test — not production policy
policy_config.buy_oracle: among legally buyable shop slots, if any missing core of current target exists, buy max(raw_stats) matching core (overrides roll when legal mask permits buy); else raw-stat greedy
policy_config.deploy_rule: if infer_target(board).core_have >= 1 and board is full and hand holds a relevant core not on board and a non-core board minion exists: sell weakest non-core board minion; then normal play-first greedy with Phase 2E buy oracle. Never sell seed/core board pieces to make room.

evaluation.note: Fidelity rollouts seed lobbies as base_seed + i. Not Replay Benchmark v1 agent-eval seeds.

contract.combat_note: Combat accuracy is NOT re-measured in Fidelity Benchmark v1. Prior spot-checks found ~97% outcome agreement vs Firestone; Phase 2B+ should not rewrite combat unless spot-checks regress.

decision.recommended_next_step: Guaranteeing board slots for oracle-acquired cores produces persistent assembly and coverage — design a realistic board-management policy (separate DEV calibration, not this oracle).
